scripts.ready: vp check && vp run -r test && vp run -r build
scripts.dev:web: vp run --filter @lhs-vsts/machine build && vp run web#dev
scripts.dev:backend: vp run --filter @lhs-vsts/machine build && vp run backend#start:dev
scripts.test:e2e: vp run --filter @lhs-vsts/machine build && vp run backend#test:e2e
scripts.test:cov: vp run --filter @lhs-vsts/machine test:cov && vp run backend#test:cov && vp run web#test:cov
